Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit, and K. P. S. Menon took over in 1952. The team note is wrong about "first": Pandit was the first post-independence ambassador to Moscow (1947–1949), and Radhakrishnan came second. I did not open the Wilson Center link cited earlier, so the April 1952 Stalin meeting detail is less verified than the dates.

CONFIDENCE: 92
